title: Unhandled error when viewing a missing report

body:
Synthetic demo data for Milestone 3.1 Slice 2 tenant-isolation testing (see ADR 0014) -- not a real customer report.

The session cookie is not marked Secure in the deployed configuration, so it can be sent over an unencrypted connection. Should default to Secure/HttpOnly in production.
title: Session cookie missing Secure flag

body:
Synthetic demo data for Milestone 3.1 Slice 2 tenant-isolation testing (see ADR 0014) -- not a real customer report.

The nightly export job writes its output file before acquiring the file lock, so a concurrent run can read a half-written file. Lock acquisition should happen first.
title: Export job race condition on the output file
